description: Update the caption/text of an existing post. Without a platform, only the main caption is saved, exactly as sent: existing platform variants (e.g. X, TikTok) are left unchanged and listed in warnings, and platforms without a variant publish the main caption. With a platform, only that platform's caption variant is changed (other platforms keep theirs) and the text is saved exactly as sent. TikTok allows at most 90 characters: a longer TikTok text is refused with an error, never rewritten, so shorten it yourself.

platform.description: Only update the caption for this platform

name: edit_caption
title: Edit Caption
